name: delegate
description: Read your household envelope budget, and sort transactions into envelopes.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a self-hosted Delegate budget. It can always read: every envelope and its balance, accounts and debts, transactions including the queue waiting to be categorized, spending over a period, and the full history of one envelope.

What it may change depends on the connection key. A key issued with 'Allow changes' can sort transactions into envelopes and write categorization rules. No key can move money, archive anything, apply a rule across past transactions, or alter any setting — Delegate itself refuses those.

delegate_url.title: Delegate address
delegate_url.description: Where your budget is on your network, for example http://10.0.3.4:8088. Settings → Connections shows the right one.

delegate_token.title: Connection key
delegate_token.description: Create one in Delegate under Settings → Connections. It is shown once.
